title: Choose the Home composition
question: Same marketplace world (eBay/Amazon craft). Pick how Home is structured.

options.label: Department tiles
options.thesis: Logo and search, then a full department-tile grid, then a few featured listings with charity badges.
options.viewport: Desktop Home: centered logo, search, icon-tile departments, featured listings.
options.risk: The tile grid can delay seeing actual items.

options.label: Search first
options.thesis: Search is the main object; departments shrink to a chip row; listings sit under it.
options.viewport: Desktop Home: compact chrome, dominant Search all items, chip departments, listing strip.
options.risk: Can feel like Amazon’s search page more than a category storefront.

options.label: Listings first
options.thesis: Departments are a text strip; the page is a dense product grid with a charity badge on every card.
options.viewport: Desktop Home: tight search header, text departments, four-column listings.
options.risk: Category entry is weaker; browse-by-department is less obvious.
